scope: Independent source review plus standard-library provenance, import, and seed-map checks. End-to-end CPU execution and SCC GPU preflight are separate checks.

review_findings.finding: Completed result rows must equal their separately hashed method metrics.
review_findings.implementation: common.validate_task_record requires metrics.json paths, exact row equality, required data/model/selection/generated artifacts, and bound checksums.

review_findings.finding: Completed-task fast reuse must validate its evaluation reference before returning.
review_findings.implementation: run_experiment.run now validates the reference before completed-task reuse and compares both method reference_sha256 fields with the validated reference.

source_review_checks: Networks, three-fold separate lambda/duration selection, common cosine prefix, losses, negative sampling, and reference-aware DSM remain byte-identical to the pilot.
Both methods use paired training data and folds; fitting seeds separate sample sizes and replications; method execution order alternates.
The selected q_T initialization, M=400, K=1000, T=3, delta=0.001, noisy last step, and absence of terminal correction are preserved.
Target simulation is confined to data/reference preparation. Target evaluation is constructed after both models have selected, refitted, and generated samples.
Generic CUDA is resolved to a concrete device for the posterior equality check in generation and preflight. DSM reference objects are created from actual tensor devices.
Completed fitting stages and sampling chunks are checked against immutable identities and checksums; interrupted folds are moved outside the CV candidate tree and restarted deterministically.
Timing fields sum their stated completed training, validation, refit, sampling, serialization, and evaluation stages; paired elapsed time is recorded separately.
Per-stage environment records retain GPU/model/software information across resumption; same-GPU wording applies to uninterrupted paired tasks.
